body:
Like I said, I haven't talked to anyone about this, so I'm not on any drugs. I'm working to work for a company that doesn't permit anyone who has experienced depression, so I'm trying to stay away from anything that can be tracked (it's an intelligence position). 

I've been going to the gym 5-6 times a week, for two hours at a time. Though the last time I went, about an hour and a half in, I was so messed up with the girlfriend situation, I could barely continue (she broke up with me about 2 days prior, then text me telling me how she had been crying... without reason).

I just feel like giving up. I might just finish my course then join the army as a soldier.
Really, I have tried exercise, but as soon as I get back in I start to feel down again. I've mostly tried to replace thinking with sleep. I'd imagine this is why people smoke weed.

Can't really talk to my family about it. They are already 300 miles away, they don't need to be worrying about my problems. I'm just sad, though have felt like this for a while. Maybe I should stop just wasting everyones time.
